# GrowthLab

> GrowthLab is an 8-week online digital marketing "agency experience" running 14 September – 4 November 2026. Instead of another lecture course, participants are trained by practitioners and immediately apply each skill on a real client project with a team, finishing with a complete digital marketing strategy and campaign proposal presented to the client. Tagline: "Bridging Education & Industry."

## What it is

- Format: 8 weeks, fully online. Live training runs Mondays and Wednesdays, 6:00–8:00 PM. Team project work happens online through the week. There may be up to two optional in-person meetings.
- Volume: 16 expert-led training sessions, roughly 32 training hours total, plus a few hours of team project work each week.
- Structure: each week follows the same loop: learn a skill in training, apply it that week on a real client's project, then present. The 8-week arc: Discover, Define, Plan, Create, Build, Acquire, Measure, Optimize.
- Price: $300, one-time payment. Seats are limited. Cohort runs 14 September – 4 November 2026.
- Who it's for: people who studied marketing but can't apply it yet, or who want real practice and confidence before the job market, and something more hands-on than a course.
- No prior experience required; participants are trained from the ground up.

## What participants learn

Digital marketing strategy and business discovery, consumer behaviour and personas, market and competitor analysis, brand positioning and messaging, customer journeys and funnels, content strategy and content calendars, social media management, content and visual creation (Canva, CapCut, Reels), website/UX/landing pages, SEO and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO), Meta Ads, Google Ads, analytics and reporting (GA4, Meta insights, CPL, CAC, ROAS), email/CRM/lead nurturing, and campaign integration and optimisation.

## What participants walk away with

- A Certificate of Completion (proof of a real engagement, not a course they sat through)
- A professional portfolio piece
- A complete digital marketing strategy and campaign proposal for a real client
- Hands-on experience across strategy, content, social, ads and analytics
- Experience of agency workflow: collaboration, deadlines, feedback and presentations
